questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not identified as a new form of community?

options.A: ethnic communities, based on shared identity and experiences of discrimination
options.B: gay villages, which are formed in certain parts of large cities
options.C: sociological communities, formed by unpopular lecturers
options.D: virtual communities that exist only in cyberspace

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - sociological communities, formed by unpopular lecturers

questions.stem_text:

the Church of Greece have which of the following characteristics in common?

options.A: They are cultures as well as churches.
options.B: They practice separation of church and state.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - They are monotheistic.

options.A: embrace conventional cultural values but offer new means of achieving them
options.B: react against the loss of any meaningful religious content in the teachings of churches
options.C: adopt an attitude of mild disapproval towards mainstream social values
options.D: reject both the goals and means of conventional society and provide utopian alternatives
